title: Chord diagram
description: Flows between groups placed around a circle: each group is an arc sized by its flows, each flow a ribbon between two arcs. Undirected, a ribbon joins a pair of groups and is as wide as the flows between them in both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once), so a group that only receives flows keeps its arc; directed, every direction has its own ribbon with an arrowhead. Hover a group to highlight its ribbons, hover a ribbon to read both directions; the legend hides / shows groups and the arrow keys walk through groups then ribbons.

support.notes: Shape charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free shape engine: legend toggles (controlled hidden), tap to highlight with the canvas tooltip, entry / update animations, sunburst drill-down with onDrill, and a generic ShapeChart taking any shape type's options. No keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

api.notes: Shape charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free shape engine: legend toggles (controlled hidden), tap to highlight with the canvas tooltip, entry / update animations, sunburst drill-down with onDrill, and a generic ShapeChart taking any shape type's options. No keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

props.name: groups
props.description: Groups (names or `{ name, color }`), in their order around the circle; groups only named by `links` are appended. With `matrix`, unnamed rows are numbered from 1.

props.name: matrix
props.description: Square flow matrix: `matrix[i][j]` flows from group `i` to group `j` (used when `links` is absent)

props.name: links
props.description: Flows as a list (by group name or index); takes precedence over `matrix`

props.name: directed
props.description: `false`: one ribbon per pair of groups, as wide as the flows between them in both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once), arcs sized by the ribbons of the group. `true`: one ribbon per direction (same width at both ends), arcs sized by the outgoing plus the incoming flows; flows from a group to itself are ignored.

props.name: arrows
props.description: Arrowheads at the target end of the ribbons

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between the groups, in degrees

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Angle of the first group, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock

props.name: sortGroups
props.description: Order of the groups around the circle

props.name: sortSubgroups
props.description: Order of the ribbon ends along an arc: `auto` minimizes the crossings; otherwise the order of the groups, or by value

props.name: ribbonColor
props.description: Color of the ribbons without `color`: a gradient from the source to the target color, one of the two, or a neutral gray

props.name: ribbonOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the ribbons, 0-1 (highlighted ribbons are more opaque)

props.name: arcWidth
props.description: Thickness of the group arcs, in pixels

props.name: ticks
props.description: Value ticks outside the arcs (labelled where there is room); a number sets the step between ticks

props.name: tickFormat
props.description: Formats the tick labels

props.name: labels
props.description: Group labels along the arc (`tangential`) or the radius (`radial`); `auto` picks tangential when every name fits; colliding labels are shortened or skipped

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` tokens, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; tapping an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip drawn on the canvas (`render` may return its text); `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend taps then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates). Mini-programs have no `<html lang>`: pass the app language

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: disableScroll
props.description: Keeps the page from scrolling while a finger moves on the chart

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the `<Canvas>` (generated by default)

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the highlighted mark changes (tap, or the mouse on H5)

events.name: onClick
events.description: Called when a mark is tapped

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a legend item is tapped (or the instance's `toggle()` is called), with the toggled index and every hidden index after the toggle

translationResources.title: Chord diagram
translationResources.description: Flows between groups placed around a circle: each group is an arc sized by its flows, each flow a ribbon between two arcs. Undirected, a ribbon joins a pair of groups and is as wide as the flows between them in both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once), so a group that only receives flows keeps its arc; directed, every direction has its own ribbon with an arrowhead. Hover a group to highlight its ribbons, hover a ribbon to read both directions; the legend hides / shows groups and the arrow keys walk through groups then ribbons.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: A square matrix and the names of its rows: matrix[i][j] flows from group i to group j, here the messages the teams send each other in a week. Ticks mark the values around the arcs when the diagram is large enough.

migration.title: Migration between regions
migration.description: Each region's arc adds up the migrants leaving and arriving; a ribbon is as wide as the moves between two regions both ways, and its tooltip splits them (Value, Reverse). The diagonal (migration within a region) is drawn as a loop. groups sets the colors, format the unit, padAngle widens the gaps.

dependencies.title: Module dependency matrix
dependencies.description: Imports between the modules of a codebase. directed draws one ribbon per direction with an arrowhead at the imported module; ribbonColor="source" colors them by importer, so import cycles (two arrows between the same modules) stand out. labels="radial" writes the names along the radius.

trade.title: Trade between economies
trade.description: Bilateral goods trade given as a links list ({ source, target, value }) instead of a matrix. sortGroups="descending" puts the biggest traders first; the tooltip of a ribbon shows the exports one way (Value) and the other (Reverse), formatted as compact US dollars.

directed.title: Directed flows with arrows
directed.description: Navigation between the pages of a shop app. Arcs add up the visits leaving and entering each page; onHover reports the hovered ribbon's source, target, value and reverseValue, shown in the caption below.

dark.title: Dark console
dark.description: The chart reads its colors from the CSS variables of its container, here a dark operations console, with a neon palette, thinner arcs (arcWidth) and lighter ribbons (ribbonOpacity).

options.title: Options
options.description: Try the label modes (auto picks tangential labels when every name fits its arc, radial ones otherwise), the group order, the ribbon colors, directed ribbons and the ticks.

brand-switching.title: Brand switching
brand-switching.description: Subscribers moving between mobile operators, one matrix per year. directed draws one ribbon per direction and ribbonColor="target" colors it by the operator that won the subscribers; the net gains are computed from the same matrix.

focus.title: Focus on a group
focus.description: Co-authored papers between faculties. onClick on an arc keeps that faculty's ribbons and gives the others a neutral color through the link color, then lists its main partners; clicking a ribbon reports the pair.

co-purchase.title: Market basket
co-purchase.description: Categories bought together in the same basket. sortGroups and sortSubgroups="descending" put the biggest categories and pairings first, ticks={1000} sets the tick step with a compact tickFormat, and renderTooltip shows a pairing as a share of all baskets.

live.title: Live service calls
live.description: Calls per second between microservices, refreshed every 2 seconds with an animated transition. directed with ribbonColor="source" shows who calls whom; the caption gives the total and the busiest call.

legend.title: Controlled legend
legend.description: Passengers between airport hubs. legend={{ position: "top" }} toggles the hubs, and with hidden + onToggle the hidden list lives in the page, so the buttons can show presets and the caption adds up the routes still visible.

ChordGroup.name: Name shown in the label, the legend and the tooltip; links refer to the group by this name (or by index)
ChordGroup.color: Color of the arc and of its ribbons' ends; taken from the palette when omitted

ChordLink.source: Source group: its name, or its index in groups
ChordLink.target: Target group: its name, or its index in groups

ChordLink.color: Color of the ribbon; follows ribbonColor when omitted

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (ChordChartOptions: padAngle, startAngle, sortGroups, sortSubgroups, ribbonOpacity, arcWidth, ticks, arrows, palette, format, percentFormat…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) group or ribbon changed; detail: { index, name, value, percent, color, source, target, reverseValue }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A group or ribbon was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, percent, color, source, target, reverseValue }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a group by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
